_comment: PT4 base column -> FPDB-3 LEGACY HandsPlayers column, for the .pt4stat importer (fpdb_3_legacy/pt4_import.py). Distinct from pt4_statistics_mapping.json, which targets the MODERN/Rust snake_case schema (all_in_ev, street0_4b_done) and is used for Rust parity. Every 'fpdb' column here is verified to exist in the deployed legacy HandsPlayers table. 'scale' divides the stored value (money/chips columns are stored x100). Semantics are best-effort parity; review imported non-ChipEV stats before relying on them.

columns._note_preflop: Done/opportunity pairs enable ratio stats (e.g. 3Bet% = cnt_p_3bet/cnt_p_3bet_opp). The _opp suffix convention is confirmed by sample files (flg_t_open_opp). FPDB *Chance columns verified to exist in HandsPlayers.
columns._note_bets: PT4's flg_x_bet is a bet on that street; fpdb's streetNAggr also counts raises, streetNBets is the bet itself.
columns._note_postflop: Flags and per-street action counts behind the stock cash stats (#613): c-bet, fold to c-bet, saw flop, the folds, bets, raises and calls of AF and AFq. fpdb stores PT4's flg_x_fold under the same names.
columns._note_blinds: PT4 counts a steal defence from either blind; fpdb keeps the small and big blind apart, so the PT4 flag maps to their sum.

conditions._comment: sum(if[<condition>, 1, 0]) with a condition richer than one flag. Keys are the condition with its table prefixes dropped and single spaces around comparison operators, as pt4_import normalises it.

named_columns._comment: PT4 columns whose SQL fpdb cannot rebuild piece by piece, but whose meaning it records under a definition of its own. Used only when the column's SQL does not translate; the note goes with every stat that relies on it.

cnt_pfr_opp.note: PT4 counts a preflop raise opportunity from the player's preflop actions and stack; fpdb's street0AggrChance is any preflop decision with a raise still possible.

expressions._comment: Sub-expressions of a PT4 value expression that fpdb answers with one column of its own, under the definition the note states.

cnt_hands - cnt_walks.note: PT4's VPIP opportunity is every hand but a walk; fpdb's also leaves out a blind that folds or is all-in before acting.
